data.long_meaning: Sharwa means 'ruler' and Meet means 'gods'. Thus, Sharwameet means 'Ruler of Gods'. The name Sharwameet carries the meaning “Ruler of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwameet usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In Hindu mythology, gods and goddesses are often depicted as rulers of various aspects of the universe and human life. The name Sharwameet pays homage to this notion by associating the individual with the divine rulers themselves.
